details.publicNotes:
Standing over ten feet tall, the large sapient mushrooms known as bolbaloses live in densely forested areas where moisture and shade abound. Their two large oval eyes, which range in shades from deep red to pitch black, move independently from one another, each attached to its two-foot-long eyestalk. A bolbalos stores decaying matter for later digestion in the protruding belly on its bulky stem, which also serves as its primary means of defense.

Most bolbaloses are notoriously friendly and quick to approach unfamiliar faces. Their curiosity drives them to ask endless questions and to seek ways to help the travelers they come across. If they can't provide the assistance that someone requests, they try to find someone else who can. While bolbaloses prefer nonviolent solutions whenever possible, they begrudgingly fight to defend themselves and their allies from harm. People who have committed terrible crimes sometimes flee to a bolbalos's territory for protection, trusting the giant mushrooms to shelter them from anyone who might come after them for justice or vengeance.

Though bolbaloses can live for centuries, their numbers are few. Their delicate spores can only germinate with a precise combination of weather conditions and sufficient primal magic. Additionally, few bolbaloses survive to die of natural causes before their curiosity and jovial meddling get them in over their heads.

Ever the Optimists

Bolbaloses are often wise enough to recognize people of ill intent but idealistic enough to believe that, with the right nudge (and perhaps a sternly delivered but well-meaning tummy whack or two), they can be encouraged to change for the better. A fugitive from justice that begs for sanctuary among bolbaloses is sure to receive aid. These bolbalos reclamation projects have had mixed success; while some guests take advantage of their hosts' protection in order to continue their evil ways, others are genuinely redeemed by the bolbaloses' trust and kindness.

Trigger An enemy critically fails a Strike against the bolbalos

Effect The bolbalos chooses a target within reach or range of the triggering attack, using themselves as the origin of the attack. The attacker then rerolls the attack against the new target.

Bolbaloses are intrinsically curious and trusting of others. During the first round of combat, the bolbalos is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until they have acted. If the penalty to AC from being off-guard causes them to take damage, they are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} for 1 round. They can use this extra action only to Stride or Step.

A Large or smaller creature hit by the bolbalos's red slime is covered by quickly hardening goo and must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:25] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes a –10 foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds for 1 round or until it Escapes.

Failure As success, and the creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} for 1 round or until it Escapes and is sickened 1.

Medium or smaller, belly, @Check[reflex|dc:28|basic]. A creature that critically fails the saving throw is knocked @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Trample]

Bolbaloses thoroughly enjoy moving things around with their bellies. They can @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} creatures using only their bellies, and they can Shove creatures up to two sizes larger than themselves.

The bolbalos spins around, haphazardly slamming any enemies surrounding them. They make a belly Strike against each enemy within reach. These attacks count toward their multiple attack penalty, but their multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after all the attacks. After using Blundering Slam, the bolbalos becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} and can't use this ability again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge this ability]]{1d4 rounds}.
